For all eight immediate declarations, the explicit-nil inherited-MainActor subset matches Swift's guaranteed causal behavior: an operation starts synchronously before its add call returns, resumes after forced suspension, preserves Task.name, and is joined at scope exit; an active conditional call returns true, while a call after cancelAll returns false without creating the child and before preference validation. No sibling finish order or physical-thread behavior is claimed. The sixteen ordinary executor-preference rows and eight immediate rows therefore remain known divergences together with arbitrary @isolated(any) operation-executor behavior.
